rows.office_of_the_collector_and_district_mag: Department of AYUSH (National AYUSH Mission), Telangana
AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Psychosocial Counselor, Yoga Professional, Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW)
Rs. 15,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- per month (Rs. 500/- per session for Psychosocial Counselor)
Offline (In person or by Registered Post)

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: A total of 8 vacancies across 5 categories are sanctioned for engagement on an outsourcing basis in Siddipet District through the District Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as reckoned on 01/07/2026.

rows.qualification: Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems, both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship.
Must possess any of the following qualifications: D Pharmacy, B Pharmacy, or Pharma D. Must be registered with the Telangana Pharmacy Council.

Post Graduate Degree in Master of Social Work (MSW) awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission.

Must possess Degree in Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems, both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship; OR Diploma in Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government.
Must have passed VII Class examination. Must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle.

rows.relaxation: 3 (Three) years in addition to the length of service in the armed forces

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The recruitment is purely on an outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027 to carry out AYUSH Public Health Programmes in Siddipet District under the administrative control of the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad. Thereafter, services will be as per the need and subject to satisfactory performance. The selection will be made through the District Selection Committee based on merit out of 100 total marks: AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Psychosocial Counselor, and Yoga Professional: 90 marks will be allotted based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination. Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW): 90 marks will be allotted for a written test. Conduct of the exam will be notified through the official website of Siddipet District. Age Weightage (All Posts): 10 marks are awarded for age, reckoned from 18 years of age as on 01.07.2026 (0.5 mark for each completed year of age up to a maximum of 10 marks). Psychosocial Counselor: A panel of eligible candidates will be empaneled and engaged on a call basis as and when required. Unit of Appointment: 95% local reservation applies. AYUSH Medical Officer is a Multi Zonal cadre post (can apply in any district in the concerned Multi Zone, restricted to one district selection). Pharmacist, MPW, Psychosocial Counselor, and Yoga Professional are District cadre posts.

rows.pay_level_pay: @ Rs. 500/- per session & atleast 200 visits in a year (on Call)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Collectorate Siddipet Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official application form and instructions from the official website (siddipet.telangana.gov.in). Fill in all the required particulars on the application form and paste one recent photograph. Enclose gazetted-attested copies of all requisite certificates, marks memos, and an acknowledgment card. Submit the completed application form in person or send it via Registered Post to the address: Government Integrated AYUSH Hospital (opposite Government Medical College), Ensanpally Village, Siddipet Urban Mandal, Siddipet District, 502114. Ensure the application reaches the designated hospital between 21-10-2026 and 31-10-2026 between 10:30 AM to 05:00 PM on working days.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC or equivalent examination certificate Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration Certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification and Medical Officer Posts) Registration Certificate of the Telangana Pharmacy Council (for Pharmacist post) Latest Caste Certificates issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study Certificate for the years from 4th Class to 10th class (in case of Private Study, Residency Certificate from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned) PH Certificate in respect of candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant Certificates in respect of candidates claiming Ex-service man quota 1 Photograph duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgment card

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released under Collectorate Siddipet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies released across 5 different posts on an outsourcing basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application in person or by registered post is 31-10-2026 up to 05:00 PM on working days.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Collectorate Siddipet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01/07/2026, with age relaxations applicable as per rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for an AYUSH Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay for an AYUSH Medical Officer is Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is the appointment permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The recruitment is made purely on an outsourcing basis up to 31/03/2027 under National AYUSH Mission.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW)?
faq.answer: Selection for MPW will be based on 90 marks for a written test and 10 marks weightage for age.

faq.question: Q7. Who gets age relaxation under this recruitment?
faq.answer: Age relaxation of 5 years is provided to SC, ST, and BC candidates, 3 years plus length of service for Ex-Service men, and 10 years for disabled persons.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted to Government Integrated AYUSH Hospital (opposite Government Medical College), Ensanpally Village, Siddipet Urban Mandal, Siddipet District, 502114.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any local candidate reservation?
faq.answer: Yes, 95% local reservation is applicable as per the Presidential Order.
